name: The Riven Wilds
notes: Hand-made expedition map for the top tier (tools/make_riven.py; format in tools/make_hollowcrown.py). A raised core (the Rift and its Sanctum), a ring of six regions each with one plateau up its stairs and most with a boss lair, six outer isles with the landings and exits, four corner rocks, and a winding sky train between the ring and the outer isles. Every height is walked up: no perches or jump pads.

regions.name: The Rift
regions.purpose: Contested core: the vault on the Sanctum, the richest loot and the most Blight. Two land bridges (north and south); glide in from the four diagonal regions.

regions.name: Rimeholt
regions.purpose: Northern frost ridge: the Keep's plateau looks down the Rime Span into the Rift; no lair, the vault's favourite.

regions.name: Galewrack
regions.purpose: Storm-lashed tableland with the Thunderwell (the Sky Serpent) and the longest glide into the Rift.

regions.name: Slagmarch
regions.purpose: Ember country: the Kilnworks plateau over the Slag Forge (the Colossus); the train's Rift run starts at its feet.

regions.name: Briarmaw
regions.purpose: Thick bramble wood, ambush country: a Boki nest, the Briar Hive (the Brood Mother) and the Briar Span to the Rift.

regions.name: Fallowmere
regions.purpose: Long-grass meadow with a Boki nest, Haystack Rise and the Barrowdeep (the Colossus).

regions.name: Gloamwood
regions.purpose: Dim wood round the shrine on Shrine Hill, with the Gloam Nest (the Brood Mother).

regions.name: Windward Shoal
regions.purpose: Quiet outer landing with a sky-train stop and a way out.
